name: Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project (508 KM Bullet Train)

name: Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC)

aiPrescription: Prioritize JNPT south port final 18km link commissioning; no further financial escalation anticipated.

name: BharatNet - National Optical Fibre Network Phase II
